rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: BlueNexus Universal MCP provides a single endpoint that gives AI systems instant access to users' data across 200+ services, handling OAuth token management and context optimization automatically. The platform supports Claude, ChatGPT, and Microsoft Copilot with enterprise security features including TEE confidential computing, RBAC, and audit logs. Authentication uses a Bearer token obtained after connecting your data sources through the BlueNexus dashboard.
